spans.s: विट् vt. or vi. 1P (pres. वेटति) 1. To sound; 2. to curse.

विट m. 1. A paramour, Sis.iv.48; 2. the companion of a dissolute young man or of a courtezan; (he is represented as on familiar terms with his associate and accomplished in the arts of singing and poetry, See Mrich.iv.), विटजननखघट्टितेव वीणा Mrich.i.; 3. a rogue; 4. a catamite; 5. the khadira tree; 6. the orange tree; 7. a rat; 8. a branch with its shoot.
वीटा f. A small piece of wood struck with a stick in kind of game played by boys.
विट-माक्षिक m. a kind of mineral.
विटंक m. 1. An aviary; 2. the highest point.
विटंकक n. 1. An aviary; 2. the highest point.
विटंकित a. (f. ता) Stamped, marked.
विटंकित a. (f. ता) Stamped, marked.
विटप m.n. 1. The branch of a tree or creeper, क्षपिता तद्विटपाश्रिता लता R.viii.47, K.S.vi.41, Sis.iv.48, R.x.11; 2. a bush; 3. a cluster, a thicket; 4. a septum of the scrotum.
विटपिन् m. 1. A tree; 2. the Indian fig tree.
विटपिन्-मृग m. a monkey, an ape.
विट्ठल m. Name of a form of Viṣṇu.
विट्पण्य n. goods, merchandise.
विट्कारिका f. a kind of bird.
विट्चर m. a tame hog.
विट्संग m. constipation.
विट्सारिका f. a kind of bird.

वीटि f. 1. Pieces of Areca nut with other spices folded in a leaf of the betel-plant; 2. a tie, a knot (of a wearing garment), त्वं मुग्धाक्षि विनैव कंचुलिकया धत्से मनोहारिणीं शोभामित्यभिधायिनि प्रियतमे तद्वीटिकासंस्पृशि Am.
